tooltip.tentnets.anti_drone_net.desc: Drones and air drops explode on it. Bullets pass through.
tooltip.tentnets.mask_net.desc: Hides everything below from aerial view and hides nametags.
tooltip.tentnets.controls.1: Right-click a block: set an anchor point
tooltip.tentnets.controls.2: Shift + right-click: stretch the net (3+ points)
tooltip.tentnets.controls.3: Right-click air: undo point; Shift + right-click air with no points: remove net
tentnets.duplicate: There is already a point here
tentnets.too_far: Too far from the first point (max %s blocks)
tentnets.need_points: At least 3 points needed: right-click blocks
tentnets.invalid: Points are collinear or the area is too small
tentnets.help: Right-click a block for a point, Shift + right-click to stretch
